exposure: Minimum evidence-based care (MEC) in the antenatal management of fetuses with intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR)
Antenatal management of IUGR according to CNGOF recommendations
outcome: Neonatal prognosis (composite criterion including neonatal morbidity and mortality)
cohort: The study included 1020 fetuses with intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) selected from a historical cohort of 31,052 children born at Femme Mere Enfant hospital in Lyon, France, between January 1, 2011, and December 31, 2017.
finding: The application of minimum evidence-based care (MEC) during antenatal management improved the neonatal prognosis for fetuses with early-onset IUGR and for those born before 32 weeks gestational age.
